pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Mounts: Legacy$(): hatch a dragon egg and raise it into a mount. The breed depends on where the egg hatches, so try different places. The Ender Dragon's egg is the first you will get.
$(bold)RevampedWolf$(): better wolves.$(br)$(bold)Pet Cemetery$(): bring a dead pet back.$(br)$(bold)Incubation$(): chicken nests and egg handling.
